findings.summary: The ingress now provides the single sanitized client address required by the intake rate-key boundary.
findings.consequence: Trusted chains receive independent client quotas while an untrusted direct request cannot choose its identity through spoofed X-Forwarded-For.
findings.evidence: lb-infra 1dc00415 overwrites XFF with Caddy's {client_ip} in all four proxy branches after strict trust processing; Nuxt accepts it only from configured ingress 10.0.0.40/32.
findings.recommendation: Retain four-branch completeness, strict trust, single-address replacement, and direct-spoof/independent-quota tests.
findings.resolution: lb-infra commit 1dc00415 normalizes every ingress proxy branch to one Caddy-sanitized client address.

findings.recommendation: Retain explicit payload-only mapping and same-event redelivery coverage.
